braz_por.description:
O [b]Community Mod Framework (CMF)[/b] é um mod utilitário que visa melhorar a interoperabilidade entre mods, ao mesmo tempo que fornece ferramentas para criadores de mods desenvolverem novas funcionalidades.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/assets/images/cmf/CMF_Banner.png[/img]

[b]O CMF deve ser carregado primeiro na sua ordem de carregamento de mods.[/b]

Qualquer dúvida, sinta-se à vontade para entrar em contato no Discord do EU5 Mod Coop: https://discord.gg/aqAAcCZsY7

[h1]Funcionalidades[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]Community Mod Menu (CMM):[/url][/b] Um menu de mods compartilhado dentro do jogo. Autores de mods registram configurações dinamicamente através de uma API simples, sem a necessidade de criar uma interface de configurações personalizada.
  [list]
   [*]Configurações de alternador (toggle), botão, numérico, controle deslizante (clique duplo para arrastar), menu suspenso, texto (apenas um jogador) e lista.
   [*]Abas por mod, grupos e busca.
   [*]Configurações globais com edição restrita ao host no modo multijogador.
   [*]Redefinir para os Padrões.
   [*]Janela arrastável.
   [*]Pode ser aberto pelo menu de escape no jogo. Ou através de uma tecla de atalho ('m' por padrão, pode ser redefinida).
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM Visual Editor[/url]: ferramenta baseada em navegador para criar seu menu de mod.
  [/list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Custom-Alerts]Alertas Personalizados:[/url][/b] Crie e exiba alertas personalizados na barra de alertas através de chaves de localização.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]Barra de Ações:[/url][/b] Adicione botões personalizados à barra de ações com chaves de localização.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks#country-transfer]Transferência de País:[/url][/b] As configurações do CMM são transferidas automaticamente ao trocar de país (trocas de tag, herança, etc.).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger]Gatilho is_host:[/url][/b] Verifica se o país atual é controlado pelo jogador host.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]Alternador de Ferramentas Irrestritas:[/url][/b] Bloqueie recursos restritos atrás de uma configuração "Habilitar Ferramentas Irrestritas" (gatilho cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools, flag cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled por configuração). Disponível apenas para o host no multijogador.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Warning-Suppression]Efeito cmf_suppress:[/url][/b] Suprima avisos da engine de "usado, mas nunca definido" e "definido, mas nunca usado" com uma única chamada de efeito.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]Macros de GUI:[/url][/b] Macros de operadores lógicos Nand, Nor e Xor.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]Hooks de On-Action:[/url][/b] Hooks de início de jogo pós-lobby e carregamento de save (on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby) com variantes para o país do jogador. Também inclui pulsos anuais e mensais compartilhados para jogadores humanos.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]Utilitários de Mapa de Variáveis:[/url][/b] Auxiliares seguros de mutação de mapa de variáveis (cmf_change_variable_map e variantes locais/globais) que lidam com a remoção e adição de forma atômica.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]Log de Ações de Mod:[/url][/b] Log global dentro do jogo para registrar ações de mods (ex: ações de ferramentas de host no multijogador, já que o log não pode ser apagado no MP).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]Community Mod Toolkit (CMT):[/url][/b] Um conjunto complementar de ferramentas de desenvolvimento, como um modelo de mod, uploader da oficina e tradutor de mods.
[/list]

[h1]Documentação[/h1]
[list]
 [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki]Wiki no GitHub[/url]: Documentação completa
 [*][url=https://eu5.paradoxwikis.com/Community_Mod_Framework]EU5 Paradox Wiki[/url]: Referência rápida

french.description:
Le [b]Community Mod Framework (CMF)[/b] est un mod utilitaire qui vise à améliorer l'interopérabilité des mods tout en offrant aux moddeurs des outils pour créer de nouvelles fonctionnalités.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/assets/images/cmf/CMF_Banner.png[/img]

[b]CMF doit être chargé en premier dans l'ordre de chargement de vos mods.[/b]

Pour toute question, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter sur le Discord EU5 Mod Coop : https://discord.gg/aqAAcCZsY7

[h1]Fonctionnalités[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]Community Mod Menu (CMM) :[/url][/b] Un menu de mod partagé en jeu. Les auteurs de mods enregistrent les paramètres dynamiquement via une API simple, sans avoir besoin de construire une interface de paramètres personnalisée.
  [list]
   [*]Paramètres de type interrupteur, bouton, numérique, curseur (double-cliquer pour faire glisser), menu déroulant, texte (solo uniquement) et liste.
   [*]Onglets par mod, groupes et recherche.
   [*]Paramètres globaux avec édition réservée à l'hôte en multijoueur.
   [*]Réinitialisation aux valeurs par défaut.
   [*]Fenêtre déplaçable.
   [*]Peut être ouvert depuis le menu Échap en jeu, ou via un raccourci clavier ('m' par défaut, peut être modifié).
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM Visual Editor[/url] : outil par navigateur pour créer votre menu de mod.
  [/list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Custom-Alerts]Alertes personnalisées :[/url][/b] Créez et affichez des alertes personnalisées dans la barre d'alertes via des clés de localisation.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]Barre d'action :[/url][/b] Ajoutez des boutons personnalisés à la barre d'action avec des clés de localisation.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks#country-transfer]Transfert de pays :[/url][/b] Les paramètres du CMM sont automatiquement transférés lors d'un changement de pays (changement de tag, héritage, etc.).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger]Trigger is_host :[/url][/b] Vérifie si le pays actuel est contrôlé par le joueur hôte.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]Bouton d'outils non restreints :[/url][/b] Verrouillez les fonctionnalités restreintes derrière un paramètre "Activer les outils non restreints" (trigger cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools, flag cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled par paramètre). Disponible uniquement pour l'hôte en multijoueur.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Warning-Suppression]Effet cmf_suppress :[/url][/b] Supprimez les avertissements du moteur "utilisé mais jamais défini" et "défini mais jamais utilisé" avec un seul appel d'effet.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]Macros GUI :[/url][/b] Macros d'opérateurs logiques Nand, Nor et Xor.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]Hooks On-Action :[/url][/b] Hooks de début de partie après le lobby et de chargement de sauvegarde (on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby) avec des variantes pour le pays du joueur. Inclut également des pulses annuels et mensuels partagés pour les joueurs humains.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]Utilitaires de Variable Map :[/url][/b] Aides à la mutation sécurisée des maps de variables (cmf_change_variable_map et variantes locales/globales) qui gèrent la suppression puis l'ajout de manière atomique.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]Journal d'actions de mod :[/url][/b] Journal global en jeu pour enregistrer les actions des mods (ex : actions d'outils de l'hôte en multijoueur, car le journal ne peut pas être effacé en MP).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]Community Mod Toolkit (CMT) :[/url][/b] Un ensemble d'outils de développement compagnon, comprenant un modèle de mod, un utilitaire d'upload sur le workshop et un traducteur de mod.
[/list]

[h1]Documentation[/h1]

german.description:
Das [b]Community Mod Framework (CMF)[/b] ist eine Utility-Mod, die darauf abzielt, die Interoperabilität von Mods zu verbessern und Moddern gleichzeitig Werkzeuge zur Erstellung neuer Funktionen an die Hand zu geben.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/assets/images/cmf/CMF_Banner.png[/img]

[b]CMF sollte in deiner Mod-Ladereihenfolge an erster Stelle geladen werden.[/b]

Bei Fragen kannst du dich gerne an den EU5 Mod Coop Discord wenden: https://discord.gg/aqAAcCZsY7

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]Community Mod Menu (CMM):[/url][/b] Ein gemeinsames In-Game-Mod-Menü. Mod-Autoren registrieren Einstellungen dynamisch über eine einfache API, ohne dass ein eigenes Einstellungs-UI erstellt werden muss.
  [list]
   [*]Schalter (Toggle), Schaltflächen (Button), numerische Werte, Schieberegler (Doppelklick zum Ziehen), Dropdowns, Text (nur Einzelspieler) und Listen-Einstellungen
   [*]Tabs pro Mod, Gruppen und Suche
   [*]Globale Einstellungen mit Bearbeitung nur für den Host im Mehrspielermodus
   [*]Auf Standardwerte zurücksetzen
   [*]Verschiebbares Fenster
   [*]Kann über das Escape-Menü im Spiel oder per Keybind geöffnet werden (standardmäßig 'm', kann neu zugewiesen werden).
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM Visual Editor[/url]: Browser-basiertes Tool zur Erstellung deines Mod-Menüs
  [/list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Custom-Alerts]Benutzerdefinierte Alarme:[/url][/b] Erstelle und zeige benutzerdefinierte Warnmeldungen in der Alarmleiste über Lokalisierungsschlüssel an.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]Aktionsleiste:[/url][/b] Füge benutzerdefinierte Aktionsleisten-Schaltflächen mit Lokalisierungsschlüsseln hinzu.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks#country-transfer]Länderübertragung:[/url][/b] CMM-Einstellungen werden beim Länderwechsel (Tag-Wechsel, Vererbung usw.) automatisch übertragen.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger]is_host Trigger:[/url][/b] Prüfe, ob das aktuelle Land vom Host-Spieler gesteuert wird.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]Umschalter für uneingeschränkte Werkzeuge:[/url][/b] Beschränke Funktionen hinter einer "Uneingeschränkte Werkzeuge aktivieren"-Einstellung (cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools Trigger, cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled Flag pro Einstellung). Im Mehrspielermodus nur für den Host verfügbar.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Warning-Suppression]cmf_suppress Effekt:[/url][/b] Unterdrücke "used but never set" und "set but never used" Engine-Warnungen mit einem einzigen Effekt-Aufruf.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]GUI-Makros:[/url][/b] Logische Operator-Makros für Nand, Nor und Xor.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]On-Action-Hooks:[/url][/b] Hooks für den Spielstart nach der Lobby und das Laden von Spielständen (on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby) mit Varianten für Spielerländer. Enthält auch gemeinsame jährliche und monatliche Pulse für menschliche Spieler.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]Variable Map Utilities:[/url][/b] Helfer für sichere Variablen-Map-Mutationen (cmf_change_variable_map sowie lokale/globale Varianten), die das Entfernen und anschließende Hinzufügen atomar handhaben.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]Mod-Aktionsprotokoll:[/url][/b] Globales In-Game-Protokoll zur Aufzeichnung von Mod-Aktionen (z. B. Host-Werkzeug-Aktionen im Mehrspielermodus, da das Protokoll im MP nicht gelöscht werden kann).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]Community Mod Toolkit (CMT):[/url][/b] Ein begleitendes Set an Entwicklungswerkzeugen, wie eine Mod-Vorlage, ein Workshop-Uploader und ein Mod-Übersetzer.
[/list]

[h1]機能[/h1]

korean.description:
[b]Community Mod Framework (CMF)[/b]는 모더들에게 새로운 기능을 제작할 수 있는 도구를 제공하는 동시에 모드 간의 호환성을 개선하는 것을 목표로 하는 유틸리티 모드입니다.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/assets/images/cmf/CMF_Banner.png[/img]

[b]CMF는 모드 불러오기 순서에서 가장 먼저 배치되어야 합니다.[/b]

질문이 있으시다면 언제든 EU5 Mod Coop 디스코드에서 문의해 주세요: https://discord.gg/aqAAcCZsY7

[h1]주요 기능[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]커뮤니티 모드 메뉴 (CMM):[/url][/b] 공용 인게임 모드 메뉴입니다. 모드 제작자는 간단한 API를 통해 설정을 동적으로 등록할 수 있으며, 별도의 설정 UI를 구축할 필요가 없습니다.
  [list]
   [*]토글, 버튼, 숫자, 슬라이더(더블 클릭 후 드래그), 드롭다운, 텍스트(싱글플레이 전용), 리스트 설정 지원
   [*]모드별 탭, 그룹화 및 검색 기능
   [*]멀티플레이어 시 호스트 전용 편집이 가능한 글로벌 설정
   [*]기본값으로 재설정
   [*]드래그 가능한 창
   [*]인게임 ESC 메뉴 혹은 단축키(기본값 'm', 변경 가능)로 열 수 있습니다.
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM 비주얼 에디터[/url]: 모드 메뉴 제작을 위한 브라우저 기반 도구
  [/list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Custom-Alerts]커스텀 알림:[/url][/b] 로컬라이제이션 키를 통해 알림 창에 커스텀 알림을 생성하고 표시합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]액션 바:[/url][/b] 로컬라이제이션 키를 사용하여 커스텀 액션 바 버튼을 추가합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks#country-transfer]국가 이전:[/url][/b] 국가 교체 시(태그 변경, 상속 등) CMM 설정이 자동으로 이전됩니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger]is_host 트리거:[/url][/b] 현재 국가가 호스트 플레이어에 의해 제어되는지 확인합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]제한 없는 도구 토글:[/url][/b] 제한된 기능을 "제한 없는 도구 활성화(Enable Unrestricted Tools)" 설정 뒤에 배치합니다 (cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools 트리거, 설정별 cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled 플래그 사용). 멀티플레이어에서는 호스트만 사용 가능합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Warning-Suppression]cmf_suppress 이펙트:[/url][/b] 단일 이펙트 호출로 "사용되었지만 설정되지 않음(used but never set)" 및 "설정되었지만 사용되지 않음(set but never used)"과 같은 엔진 경고를 억제합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]GUI 매크로:[/url][/b] Nand, Nor, Xor 논리 연산자 매크로를 제공합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]온-액션 훅(On-Action Hooks):[/url][/b] 플레이어 국가 변형이 포함된 로비 이후 게임 시작 및 세이브 로드 훅(on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby)을 제공합니다. 또한 인간 플레이어를 위한 공용 연간 및 월간 펄스(Pulse)를 포함합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]변수 맵 유틸리티:[/url][/b] 제거 후 추가 과정을 원자적(atomically)으로 처리하는 안전한 변수 맵 변경 헬퍼(cmf_change_variable_map 및 로컬/글로벌 변형)를 제공합니다.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]모드 액션 로그:[/url][/b] 모드 동작을 기록하기 위한 글로벌 인게임 로그입니다(예: 멀티플레이어에서 로그 삭제가 불가능한 점을 이용한 호스트 도구 작업 기록).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]커뮤니티 모드 툴킷 (CMT):[/url][/b] 모드 템플릿, 창작마당 업로더, 모드 번역기 등과 같은 보조 개발 도구 모음입니다.
[/list]

[h1]문서[/h1]
[list]
 [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki]GitHub 위키[/url]: 전체 문서

[b]Community Mod Framework (CMF)[/b] to mod narzędziowy, którego celem jest poprawa interoperacyjności modów przy jednoczesnym zapewnieniu moderom narzędzi do tworzenia nowych funkcji.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/assets/images/cmf/CMF_Banner.png[/img]

[b]CMF powinien być ładowany jako pierwszy w Twojej kolejności wczytywania modów.[/b]

W razie pytań zapraszamy do kontaktu na Discordzie EU5 Mod Coop: https://discord.gg/aqAAcCZsY7

[h1]Funkcje[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]Community Mod Menu (CMM):[/url][/b] Wspólne menu modów w grze. Autorzy modów rejestrują ustawienia dynamicznie poprzez proste API, bez konieczności budowania własnego interfejsu ustawień.
  [list]
   [*]Przełączniki, przyciski, wartości liczbowe, suwaki (kliknij dwukrotnie, aby przeciągnąć), menu rozwijane, pole tekstowe (tylko tryb jednoosobowy) oraz ustawienia listy.
   [*]Zakładki dla poszczególnych modów, grupy i wyszukiwarka.
   [*]Ustawienia globalne z edycją tylko dla hosta w trybie wieloosobowym.
   [*]Przywracanie ustawień domyślnych.
   [*]Przeciągalne okno.
   [*]Można otworzyć z menu pauzy w grze lub za pomocą skrótu klawiszowego (domyślnie 'm', można zmienić).
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM Visual Editor[/url]: narzędzie przeglądarkowe do tworzenia menu Twojego moda.
  [/list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Custom-Alerts]Custom Alerts:[/url][/b] Twórz i wyświetlaj niestandardowe alerty na pasku alertów za pomocą kluczy lokalizacyjnych.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]Action Bar:[/url][/b] Dodawaj własne przyciski paska akcji za pomocą kluczy lokalizacyjnych.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks#country-transfer]Country Transfer:[/url][/b] Ustawienia CMM przenoszą się automatycznie przy zmianie kraju (zmiana tagu, dziedziczenie itp.).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger]is_host Trigger:[/url][/b] Sprawdza, czy obecny kraj jest kontrolowany przez hosta.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]Unrestricted Tools Toggle:[/url][/b] Możliwość zablokowania funkcji za ustawieniem „Włącz nieograniczone narzędzia” (trigger cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools, flaga cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled dla poszczególnych ustawień). Dostępne tylko dla hosta w trybie wieloosobowym.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Warning-Suppression]cmf_suppress Effect:[/url][/b] Wycisz ostrzeżenia silnika „used but never set” i „set but never used” za pomocą jednego wywołania efektu.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]GUI Macros:[/url][/b] Makra operatorów logicznych Nand, Nor i Xor.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]On-Action Hooks:[/url][/b] Hooki startu gry po lobby oraz wczytywania zapisu (on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby) z wariantami dla kraju gracza. Zawiera również wspólne pulsy roczne i miesięczne dla graczy ludzkich.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]Variable Map Utilities:[/url][/b] Pomocniki do bezpiecznej mutacji map zmiennych (cmf_change_variable_map oraz warianty lokalne/globalne), które atomowo obsługują operacje usuwania i dodawania.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]Mod Action Log:[/url][/b] Globalny log w grze do rejestrowania akcji modów (np. akcje narzędzi hosta w trybie wieloosobowym, ponieważ loga nie można wyczyścić w MP).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]Community Mod Toolkit (CMT):[/url][/b] Zestaw narzędzi deweloperskich, takich jak szablon moda, uploader do warsztatu i translator modów.

  [list]
   [*]开关、按钮、数值、滑块（双击拖动）、下拉菜单、文本（仅限单人模式）和列表设置
   [*]每个模组独立的标签页、分组和搜索功能
   [*]全局设置，多人模式下仅房主可编辑
   [*]恢复默认设置
   [*]可拖动窗口

 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]动作栏：[/url][/b] 使用本地化键值添加自定义动作栏按钮。

 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]无限制工具开关：[/url][/b] 将受限功能锁定在“开启无限制工具”设置之后（使用 cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools 触发器，cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled 单项设置标记）。在多人模式中仅房主可用。

 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]GUI 宏：[/url][/b] 与非 (Nand)、或非 (Nor) 和异或 (Xor) 逻辑运算符宏。
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]动作钩子 (On-Action Hooks)：[/url][/b] 大厅后游戏开始和存档加载钩子（on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby），包含玩家国家变体。还包括针对人类玩家的通用年脉动和月脉动。
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]变量映射实用工具：[/url][/b] 安全的变量映射 (Variable Map) 变更辅助程序（cmf_change_variable_map 及其本地/全局变体），以原子方式处理“先删除后添加”的操作。
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]模组操作日志：[/url][/b] 用于记录模组操作的全局游戏内日志（例如多人模式中的房主工具操作，因为日志在多人模式下无法被清除）。
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]社区模组工具包 (Community Mod Toolkit, CMT)：[/url][/b] 一套配套的开发工具，例如模组模板、创意工坊上传器和模组翻译器。

[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]Community Mod Menu (CMM):[/url][/b] Un menú de mods compartido dentro del juego.   [list]

   [*]Restablecer a valores predeterminados.
   [*]Ventana arrastrable.
   [*]Se puede abrir desde el menú de escape dentro del juego, o mediante un atajo de teclado ('m' por defecto, se puede reasignar).
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM Visual Editor[/url]: herramienta basada en navegador para crear tu menú de mod.

turkish.description:
[b]Community Mod Framework (CMF)[/b], modculara yeni özellikler oluşturmaları için araçlar sunarken modlar arası birlikte çalışabilirliği artırmayı amaçlayan bir yardımcı araç modudur.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/main/assets/images/cmf/CMF_Banner.png[/img]

[b]CMF, mod yükleme sıranızda en üstte yer almalıdır.[/b]

Herhangi bir sorunuz olursa EU5 Mod Coop Discord adresi üzerinden ulaşmaktan çekinmeyin: https://discord.gg/aqAAcCZsY7

[h1]Özellikler[/h1]
[list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Community-Mod-Menu]Topluluk Mod Menüsü (CMM):[/url][/b] Paylaşılan bir oyun içi mod menüsü. Mod yazarları, basit bir API aracılığıyla ayarları dinamik olarak kaydeder; özel bir ayarlar arayüzü oluşturmaya gerek yoktur.
  [list]
   [*]Aç/kapat, düğme, sayısal, kaydırıcı (sürüklemek için çift tıklayın), açılır menü, metin (yalnızca tek oyunculu) ve liste ayarları
   [*]Mod başına sekmeler, gruplar ve arama
   [*]Sadece kurucuya özel çok oyunculu düzenleme imkanı sunan genel ayarlar
   [*]Varsayılanlara Sıfırla
   [*]Sürüklenebilir pencere
   [*]Oyun içindeki duraklatma (escape) menüsünden veya tuş atamasıyla açılabilir (varsayılan 'm' tuşudur, yeniden atanabilir).
   [*][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/CMM-Visual-Editor]CMM Görsel Düzenleyici[/url]: Mod menünüzü oluşturmak için tarayıcı tabanlı araç
  [/list]
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Custom-Alerts]Özel Uyarılar:[/url][/b] Yerelleştirme anahtarları aracılığıyla uyarı çubuğunda özel uyarılar oluşturun ve gösterin.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Action-Bar]Eylem Çubuğu:[/url][/b] Yerelleştirme anahtarlarıyla özel eylem çubuğu düğmeleri ekleyin.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks#country-transfer]Ülke Geçişi:[/url][/b] Ülke değiştirirken (etiket değişimleri, miras alma vb.) CMM ayarları otomatik olarak aktarılır.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger]is_host Tetikleyicisi:[/url][/b] Mevcut ülkenin kurucu oyuncu (host) tarafından kontrol edilip edilmediğini kontrol edin.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/is_host-Trigger#cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools]Kısıtlanmamış Araçlar Seçeneği:[/url][/b] Kısıtlanmış özellikleri "Kısıtlanmamış Araçları Etkinleştir" ayarının arkasına gizleyin (cmf_can_use_unrestricted_tools tetikleyicisi, ayar başına cmm_set_requires_unrestricted_tools_enabled bayrağı). Çok oyunculu modda sadece kurucu için mevcuttur.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Warning-Suppression]cmf_suppress Etkisi:[/url][/b] Tek bir etki çağrısı ile "kullanıldı ama asla tanımlanmadı" ve "tanımlandı ama asla kullanılmadı" motor uyarılarını engelleyin.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/GUI-Macros]GUI Makroları:[/url][/b] Nand, Nor ve Xor mantıksal işleç makroları.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/On-Action-Hooks]On-Action Kancaları:[/url][/b] Oyuncu ülke varyantlarıyla birlikte lobi sonrası oyun başlama ve kayıt yükleme kancaları (on_game_start_after_lobby, on_game_load, on_game_load_after_lobby). Ayrıca gerçek oyuncular için ortak yıllık ve aylık puls'ları içerir.
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/cmf_change_variable_map-Effect]Değişken Haritası Araçları:[/url][/b] Kaldır-ve-ekle işlemini atomik olarak gerçekleştiren güvenli değişken haritası (variable map) mutasyon yardımcıları (cmf_change_variable_map ve yerel/genel varyantları).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-framework/wiki/Mod-Action-Log]Mod Eylem Günlüğü:[/url][/b] Mod eylemlerini kaydetmek için oyun içi genel günlük (örneğin çok oyunculu modda kurucu aracı eylemleri; çünkü günlük çok oyunculu modda silinemez).
 [*][b][url=https://github.com/Europa-Universalis-5-Modding-Co-op/community-mod-toolkit]Topluluk Mod Araç Seti (CMT):[/url][/b] Mod şablonu, workshop yükleyicisi ve mod çeviricisi gibi yardımcı geliştirme araçları seti.
[/list]
